Question: After having sexual intercourse the periods doesnot stop from past 1year 6 months give some suggestion for this? Answer ID: 23022 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1267/953/H=1431) Consult any expert doctor or hakim. After each salah recite سوره الم نشرح and سوره قريش 3-3 times with durood 3-3 times before and after, blow it on water and give it to the patient to drink. May Almighty Allah give her health and cure! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
